purpose: Loads and saves plugin options (mermaid, scroll sync, auto-open, debounce delay) from/to a Notepad++ INI file via GetPrivateProfileInt/WritePrivateProfileString.
invariants: Load and Save are no-ops if path_ is empty
renderDebounceMs is clamped to [0, 1000] on both load and save
gotchas: Uses the Windows INI API (GetPrivateProfileInt) rather than a custom parser — the file is a standard .ini with section [MarkdownPlusPlus]
Booleans are stored as 0/1 integers, not true/false strings
